title: divine workshop
description: adding 25+ powerful enchantments across 5 tiers. Fully configurable, with in-game config terminal.
body:
### **Divine Workshop – Forge Your Ultimate Arsenal**

Welcome to Divine Workshop, a comprehensive enchantment expansion for Minecraft that redefines what gear can do. This mod adds over 25 new enchantments across five distinct tiers – Normal, Rare, Epic, Mythic, and Final – each with custom textures, unique mechanics, and deep customization. Whether you're exploring, building, or fighting bosses, Divine Workshop gives you the tools to play your way.

## The Divine Workshop Block
A brand-new functional block is the heart of the mod. Craft it and right-click to open a dedicated crafting interface where all enchantments are made. Every enchantment now requires a matching tier of Enchantment Book plus resources, making progression clear and rewarding.

## Resource Systems
Four new resources power your crafting:

Divine Power – gained by killing mobs
Soul Essence – converted from food
Matter – converted from ores and minerals
Divinity – earned by defeating bosses
Divinity is fully customizable: you can freely add any boss (including bosses from other mods) as a Divinity source in the config, and customize its name, color, and the Divinity it grants – perfect for modpack integration.

## Five Enchantment Book Tiers
Normal, Rare, Epic, Mythic, and Final books are the key to crafting:

Each enchantment consumes the book of its own tier (e.g., Eternal Immortality requires a Mythic Book)
Books can be found in chest loot – the higher the tier, the rarer it is (the Final book does not spawn in chests by default)
![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7e3ba90bfc20dff1f3042d6e8036bd5e06ad23b2.png)
🌟 **Handpicked Enchantment Highlights**
(This is just a taste – there are many more to discover!)

Heavenly Sword Will – Right‑click with your weapon to unleash a massive AoE slash that strikes all nearby enemies. Damage, range, and cooldown scale with level. Perfect for clearing hordes in an instant.

Undying Nirvana – Wearing a full set with this enchantment grants multiple "revive layers". On fatal damage, you resurrect in place, consuming one layer. Layers regenerate over time, and each revival gives you absorption and powerful buffs. Never fear death again.
![tooltip](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d5753f1fac4219846ad27f10a3bcdc02073ab595.png)

Sky Walker – Enchant your boots to gain creative flight while wearing them. No need for elytra or fireworks – just put on your boots and soar.

Godly Blessing – Your chestplate periodically bestows beneficial effects (like Strength, Regeneration, etc.) on you, while also afflicting nearby enemies with negative effects. The effect list is fully configurable, and you can refresh it instantly by right‑clicking the enchanted book with a Nether Star.
When you combine two Godly Blessing enchanted books (or a book with an item) in an anvil, their effect lists are merged – meaning you can build a custom blessing pool by combining multiple books with different effect sets.

Vanquish – Each level multiplies your melee damage exponentially (base factor configurable).

Eternal Immortality – Grants infinite durability to any item it's on, with automatic full‑inventory repair every few seconds. Never worry about breaking your favorite tools again.

🔧 **Unmatched Customization**
Every single enchantment is fully configurable through simple TOML files. You can adjust:

Maximum level per enchantment

Damage formulas, probabilities, durations

Effect lists (e.g., which potion effects Godly Blessing applies)

Cooldowns, ranges, and more

Changes are applied live – no restart required!

🎛️ **Endgame: Final Tier & Live Config UI**
The Final Judge (weapon) and Final Wall (armor set) unlock the ultimate control tool: an in‑game Causality Terminal GUI (press L while holding/equipping Final items). This interface lets you:

Toggle attack/defense pipelines (e.g., cancel damage, force heal, reflect, disable knockback)

Select damage types (physical, void, fire, magic, absolute, etc.)

Apply permanent attributes (max health, armor, speed, etc.)

Add infinite‑duration potion effects

Enable creative flight, entity wiping, and even global entity clearing

All changes take effect immediately – no reloading required.
![tooltip](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8a21e23e0efa86336bfcf6b7ec77cab87cd4af47.png)
![GUI-1](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ad1a5f9fc38a9c44d448deecd47a70add9d64732.png)
![GUI-2](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/58e191c3a12c91dc573804c0536451f9cef5e3bd.png)

📖 **JEI Integration & Acquisition**
Every enchantment recipe is fully integrated with JEI (Just Enough Items). Simply look up any enchantment book to see its crafting recipe, including materials and steps. No more guessing – you'll always know exactly how to obtain each enchantment.
![JEI](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7ef3b6099dfdf4172cdb3b7e7f4007515eb9c51c.png)

🎨 **Custom Book Textures**
Each tier has its own distinctive book texture:

Normal – Subtle green

Rare – Cyan glow

Epic – Purple aura

Mythic – Golden shimmer

Final – Rainbow holographic

![Custom Book Textures](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9c367304b2e4feb7dd7f06a60bd41dba7c8b9554.png)

Instantly identify enchantment power at a glance.
